blocks.x: German audio brand Sennheiser has made its mark on all types of travel experiences, from providing the ideal in-flight headphones for the Concorde, to developing microphones favored by artists on stages across the globe, to launching immersive, speakerless audio for vehicles. To put it simply, you can’t travel well without good sound, and if you’re in the market for noise-canceling headphones that’ll get you through that next long-haul flight, this audio brand’s got you covered.

Established in 1945, Sennheiser has long been a household name among audiophiles, but has also won the ears of casual listeners. It all began when Dr. Ing. Fritz Sennheiser founded Laboratorium Wennebostel outside of Hanover, which later became Sennheiser Electronic. The first product was the DM 1 microphone, made for Siemens. The company has been credited with creating the world’s first open-back headphones in 1968, and in 1991, it launched the legendary Orpheus electrostatic headphone (whose successor would be the HE 1 in 2015), followed by the Evolution Microphone Series in 1999.
The very best in sound technology doesn’t come cheap; if you’d like to shop the Sennheiser brand, read on for the coupon codes, discounts, and free shipping offers to use before making a purchase.
Use a Sennheiser coupon code for 10% off your first order

If you’re new to the brand, you’re in luck: First-time customers can sign up for the official Sennheiser newsletter to receive an exclusive 10% off coupon for their initial purchase, up to $100. And once you’re subscribed, you can stay informed about new product launches, flash sales, and subscriber-only promotions—all delivered directly to your inbox. Subscribers can also benefit from free shipping on all orders sitewide with no minimum spend, ensuring extra savings on every purchase. Once you sign up, the discount and free shipping will expire by December 31, 2026, so make sure you put it to use before then.
Keep an eye out for limited-time offers at Sennheiser

Sennheiser is currently offering limited-time discounts on industry-standard gear, including headphones and soundbars—often available without a specific code. Right now, for instance, the AMBEO Soundbar Max Refurbished has been marked down from $2,999 to $1,299.5, rounding out to a total saving of $1,700. This home theater tool will level up how you watch movies, with a 3D audio experience.
Students, military members, and first responders can enjoy a 15% discount

Sennheiser is committed to honoring those who serve our communities, from students learning how to make music to nurses who commute to work with a pair of headphones. As a gesture of gratitude, the company offers a 15% discount code to military personnel, veterans, government employees, medical professionals, first responders, seniors, students, and teachers. All you have to do is verify your status through ID.me. Once you’ve completed your verification, you’ll be given a unique promo code, which you can enter into the “Discount Code” field when purchasing an item on the Sennheiser site. Unfortunately, this code can’t be combined with other offers.
Shop refurbished Sennheiser products at a discount without a code

If you don’t mind giving up on that shiny new toy feeling, Sennheiser offers discounts on "like-new" products that have undergone professional inspection, testing, and restoration to meet original performance standards. You can find previous-generation models, open-box items, or cosmetic-blemish products—like the HD 560S or HD 599 headphones—at a fraction of their price. All refurbished products typically come with a warranty, ensuring peace of mind with your purchase, similar to new items.
What to do if your Sennheiser coupon code isn’t working

If your Sennheiser coupon code isn't working, be sure to check for typos, extra spaces, or incorrect capitalization, as well as any terms and conditions. The 10% newsletter sign-up promo code, for instance, is capped at a $100 discount and limited to first-time users only. You can also try clearing your browser’s cache and cookies, or switching devices or browsers. When all else fails, Sennheiser's Consumer Experience team is there to help.
